name: Light kit
body:
Source Undead Slayer's Handbook pg. 11
Price 170 gp; Weight 6 lbs.
Category Kits
Description
Ideal for use in subterranean environments or in combat against light-averse creatures, this small kit provides ample alchemical and magical sources of illumination. It contains an ioun torchUE, flash powderUE, a pair of sunrods, four torches, and six tindertwigs.
